name: Multicolumn
summary: Passive container-responsive list of target-owned parallel feature items beneath an optional contextual heading.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Titled thematic section or untitled generic root for one complete repeated-item composition.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional visible contextual heading that names the thematic root.

anatomy.name: grid
anatomy.description: Required target-owned native list whose items wrap through the parent responsive composition.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Repeated native list item containing meaningful target-owned feature content.

anatomy.name: icon
anatomy.description: Optional passive item visual supplied and semantically classified by the target.

anatomy.name: itemTitle
anatomy.description: Optional contextual item heading supplied at the correct document level.

anatomy.name: itemText
anatomy.description: Optional item supporting copy; every rendered item still requires meaningful text content.

behavior.name: rootSemantics
behavior.description: A non-empty title produces a thematic section named by its visible heading; an untitled composition uses a generic root rather than an unnamed section.

behavior.name: itemComposition
behavior.description: The target supplies one or more source-ordered native list items and their content semantics; the parent owns only consistent repeated-item composition.

behavior.name: responsiveComposition
behavior.description: An intrinsic repeated layout responds to component inline space without changing, duplicating, or visually reordering items.

behavior.name: omission
behavior.description: Missing required items omits the root; an empty optional title omits only the header and selects generic root semantics.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Optional non-empty visible contextual heading; when present it names the thematic root.

properties.name: items
properties.description: One or more source-ordered target-owned native list-item compositions with meaningful text content.

accessibility: When title is present, render a thematic section associated with the visible contextual heading through aria-labelledby; use a generic root when title is absent.
Render parallel features as a native ul/li list; use ol only when sequence changes meaning and route process-specific content to Process Timeline when appropriate.
Require at least one meaningful item, omit empty target records, and preserve a logical contextual heading hierarchy.
Hide decorative visuals from assistive technology; informative target media supplies native alternative text without duplicating adjacent content.
Responsive column changes must preserve DOM/source order and must not use position, icon, or color as the only meaning cue.
Add no section focus model, Arrow-key behavior, live region, drag, swipe, autoplay, timer, authored motion, or neutral runtime.
Leave item content, heading rank, native list choice, child interactions, media loading, analytics, and editor lifecycle with the owning target.

web.notes: Implemented by conditional titled-section semantics, native list fixture composition, intrinsic container-responsive CSS, strict required-slot omission, and no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Merchant-editable section maps an optional contextual title and reorderable native-list item blocks with explicit passive-media semantics and no component runtime.
